axes.repository_infrastructure_pct: Ability of the repository itself to run, recover, validate and preserve provenance.
axes.candidate_program_pct: Completeness of the research-programme architecture, gate definitions and interfaces; not scientific success.
axes.theory_established_pct: Scientific establishment of an actual QGR candidate theory. Independent of infrastructure readiness.

candidate_program_100_semantics: Research-program / roadmap infrastructure readiness only; not probability of correctness, not theory completion, and not fraction of quantum gravity solved.
